block.longDescription: API trigger to start the workflow via authenticated HTTP calls with structured input.

subBlocks.title: Input Format
subBlocks.description: Define the JSON input schema accepted by the API endpoint.

block.bestPractices:
- Can run the workflow manually to test implementation when this is the trigger point.
- The input format determines variables accessible in the following blocks. E.g. <api1.paramName>. You can set the value in the input format to test the workflow manually.
- In production, the curl would come in as e.g. curl -X POST -H "X-API-Key: $SIM_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"paramName":"example"}' https://www.staging.sim.ai/api/workflows/{workflowId}/execute -- If user asks to test via API, you might need to clarify the API key.
